tests.test: middle-layer Fourier cancellation and missing influence-to-carrier charge
tests.scope: degree-one Walsh moments vanish on power-large middle layers, and no scarce actual paired-positive carrier is attached to total influence; a theorem proving such a carrier map from common-X data remains possible

tests.test: unit-aware logarithmic-derivative decomposition on the exact translated block
tests.scope: after the Boolean vector and Laurent unit are supplied, the proposed jets are deterministic additive readouts and give no bounded inverse theorem by themselves; new nonlinear cross-row evaluations are not refuted

tests.test: root-incidence data versus exact target-target labels in a common-X scalar-copy block
tests.scope: normalized roots and resultants are unchanged while exact target-target label behaviour changes along the unit fibre, so root rank without an explicit Euclidean map cannot close; a unit-aware root theorem is not refuted

tests.test: Phi6 Boolean divisor block and translated exact paired-positive realization
tests.scope: legal paired-positive rows realize nontrivial Boolean subset structure, so incidence-only forbidden-poset reasoning supplies no power saving; a decorated theorem using unit and Euclidean data is not refuted

tests.test: abstract subset cumulants under reusable factors and Laurent translations
tests.scope: the proposed cumulant debt has no conserved actual distance carrier and is invariant under translations that change collision behaviour; an explicit same-graph debt identity remains possible

tests.test: compare t=0 and t=-1/4 exact reverse-circle realizations
tests.scope: identical normalized Boolean, factor and per-row spectrum data give 127 versus 145 exact target-target labels; this refutes determination by normalized data, not a uniform lower bound over the unit fibre

tests.test: quotient Laurent units in two otherwise identical exact realizations
tests.scope: source translation is not irrelevant to target-target collision statistics, so units cannot be silently discarded; a proof that explicitly controls or optimizes over units remains possible

tests.test: require the dual profile charge and collision fibre to live on the same all-target pair graph
tests.scope: no full-target dual charge is constructed, and normalized profiles do not determine collision behaviour; a new unit-aware charge on explicit target pairs is not refuted

tests.test: joint normalized statistic against the exact unit-translation collision pair
tests.scope: the advertised bounded statistic is constant while its collision factor changes, and no ambiguity-times-fibre bound is proved; a statistic retaining the full relevant unit data is not refuted
